description: CMMC Level 2 Command Registry for M365 GCC High

entries.label: Discover Operator User ID
entries.notes: Resolves the operator's Entra ID object ID by UPN. Captures operatorUserId for downstream role assignment and group membership entries. Evidence proves the operator identity is uniquely identified per AC.L1-3.1.1.

entries.label: Create CUI Security Group
entries.notes: Creates a dedicated Entra ID security group for CUI-authorized users. Group membership gates Conditional Access policies, sensitivity label scoping, and Information Barrier segments. Evidence proves access is limited to authorized users per AC.L1-3.1.1.

entries.label: Add User to CUI Security Group
entries.notes: Adds the operator to the CUI security group. Requires cuiGroupId and operatorUserId captured from prior entries. Evidence shows the operator is enrolled in the access-controlled group per AC.L1-3.1.1.

entries.label: RBAC Role Assignment
entries.notes: Assigns an Entra ID directory role to the operator. Uses roleDefId variable (well-known GUID for the target role). Evidence proves RBAC is enforced, limiting functions to what the role permits per AC.L2-3.1.2.

entries.label: CUI Sensitivity Label and Publishing Policy
entries.notes: Collects sensitivity label and label publishing policy evidence for CUI flow control. In GCC High, CUI flow is typically enforced via sensitivity labels + DLP rather than Information Barriers. Verifies labels exist and are published to Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

entries.label: DLP Compliance Policy for CUI Flow Control
entries.notes: Collects DLP compliance policy evidence for CUI flow control. DLP policies enforce data loss prevention rules on CUI-labeled content across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams. Complements sensitivity labels for full AC.L2-3.1.3 coverage.

entries.label: Service Principal Account Evidence for CUI Flow Control
entries.notes: Queries service principal configuration for the Stamper application. Variable {eoAppDisplayName} resolved from tenant config. Complements Information Barrier entries (ib-segment, ib-policy) for AC.L2-3.1.3.

entries.label: Get PIM Policy for Compliance Admin Role
entries.get_command: $roleId = (Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -Filter "displayName eq 'Compliance Administrator'").Id; $assignment = Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyAssignment -Filter "scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq '$roleId'" | Select-Object -First 1; Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicy -UnifiedRoleManagementPolicyId $assignment.PolicyId | Select-Object Id,DisplayName | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
evidence_commands: $roleId = (Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -Filter "displayName eq 'Compliance Administrator'").Id; $assignment = Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyAssignment -Filter "scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq '$roleId'" | Select-Object -First 1; Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicy -UnifiedRoleManagementPolicyId $assignment.PolicyId | Select-Object Id,DisplayName | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Retrieves the PIM (Privileged Identity Management) policy for the Compliance Administrator role. Captures pimPolicyId used by the pim-approval entry to configure approval requirements. Evidence proves separation of duties controls exist per AC.L2-3.1.4.

entries.label: PIM Separation of Duties - Require Approval
entries.set_command: $roleId=(Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -Filter "displayName eq 'Compliance Administrator'").Id; $pimPolicyId=(Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyAssignment -Filter "scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq '$roleId'" | Select-Object -First 1).PolicyId; $approverId=(Get-MgUser -Filter "userPrincipalName eq '{approverUPN}'").Id; $approvalStage=@{approvalStageTimeOutInDays=1;isApproverJustificationRequired=$true;isEscalationEnabled=$false;primaryApprovers=@(@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.singleUser';userId=$approverId})}; $body=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.unifiedRoleManagementPolicyApprovalRule';id='Approval_EndUser_Assignment';setting=@{isApprovalRequired=$true;isApprovalRequiredForExtension=$false;isRequestorJustificationRequired=$true;approvalMode='SingleStage';approvalStages=@($approvalStage)}}; Update-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyRule -UnifiedRoleManagementPolicyId $pimPolicyId -UnifiedRoleManagementPolicyRuleId 'Approval_EndUser_Assignment' -BodyParameter $body
entries.get_command: $roleId=(Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -Filter "displayName eq 'Compliance Administrator'").Id; $pimPolicyId=(Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyAssignment -Filter "scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq '$roleId'" | Select-Object -First 1).PolicyId; Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyRule -UnifiedRoleManagementPolicyId $pimPolicyId -Filter "id eq 'Approval_EndUser_Assignment'" | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
evidence_commands: $roleId=(Get-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleDefinition -Filter "displayName eq 'Compliance Administrator'").Id; $pimPolicyId=(Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyAssignment -Filter "scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId eq '$roleId'" | Select-Object -First 1).PolicyId; Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyRule -UnifiedRoleManagementPolicyId $pimPolicyId -Filter "id eq 'Approval_EndUser_Assignment'" | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Configures PIM approval workflow for Compliance Administrator role activation. Requires approverUPN — a different user than the requestor, enforcing separation of duties. Evidence proves dual-authorization is required for privileged role activation per AC.L2-3.1.4.

entries.label: PIM JIT Eligible Role Assignment
entries.notes: Creates a PIM eligible (JIT) role assignment instead of a permanent assignment. Assignments expire after 1 year and require activation with justification. Evidence proves least privilege via time-limited access per AC.L2-3.1.5. Also supports AC.L2-3.1.7 and SC.L2-3.13.3.

entries.label: PIM Eligible Role Assignments for Privileged Users
entries.notes: Evidence-only. Queries PIM eligible role schedules for Global Admin, Privileged Role Admin, and Security Admin. Evidence proves privileged roles use JIT activation rather than permanent assignment per AC.L2-3.1.7.

entries.label: Verify No Permanent Privileged Role Assignments
entries.notes: Evidence-only. Checks for permanent (non-expiring) assignments on privileged roles. Healthy state is zero permanent assignments — all should be PIM-eligible. Evidence proves no standing privileged access exists per AC.L2-3.1.7.

entries.label: Create Dedicated Admin Account
entries.notes: Capture adminUserId reserved for future CA exclusion entries.

entries.label: Smart Lockout Configuration Evidence
entries.notes: Smart Lockout is configured at the Entra ID tenant level (Password Protection). Get-command collects authentication methods policy as evidence.

entries.label: Create CUI Terms of Use Agreement
evidence_commands: Get-MgAgreement -Filter "displayName eq 'CUI System Access Notice'" | Select-Object Id,DisplayName,IsViewingBeforeAcceptanceRequired,Files | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Creates a Terms of Use agreement in Entra ID that users must accept before accessing CUI systems. Requires touFileName and touFileBase64 (the PDF content). Evidence proves privacy and security notices are displayed per AC.L2-3.1.9.

entries.label: Deploy Screen Lock / Session Timeout Intune Policy
entries.notes: Deploys an Intune device configuration policy enforcing 15-minute screen lock timeout and password requirement. Targets Windows 10/11 managed devices. Evidence proves session lock with pattern-hiding display per AC.L2-3.1.10.

entries.label: Conditional Access - Session Timeout and No Persistent Browser
entries.notes: Creates a Conditional Access policy enforcing 8-hour sign-in frequency and disabling persistent browser sessions. Targets CUI group members with break-glass exclusion. Evidence proves automatic session termination per AC.L2-3.1.11.

entries.label: Create Approved CUI Named Location (IP Range)
entries.notes: Creates a named location (trusted IP range) in Entra ID Conditional Access. Captures namedLocationId for use in block-untrusted-locations policy. Evidence proves remote access is monitored via network location awareness per AC.L2-3.1.12.

entries.label: Conditional Access - Block Untrusted Network Locations
entries.notes: Creates a Conditional Access policy blocking access from untrusted network locations. Uses namedLocationId to exclude approved networks. Evidence proves remote access is routed via managed access control points per AC.L2-3.1.14. Also supports SC.L2-3.13.7 split-tunneling prevention.

entries.label: Conditional Access - Admin MFA Phishing-Resistant
entries.notes: Role GUIDs: 62e90394... = Global Admin, f28a1f50... = Security Admin (Microsoft well-known IDs). Break-glass account excluded per CMMC best practice.

entries.label: Deploy WPA2-Enterprise WiFi Profile via Intune
entries.notes: Deploys a WPA2-Enterprise Wi-Fi profile via Intune device configuration. Requires wifiSsid variable. Evidence proves wireless access is authorized and configured with enterprise authentication per AC.L2-3.1.16.

entries.label: Conditional Access - Mobile Device Compliance Requirement
entries.notes: Creates a Conditional Access policy requiring compliant or approved mobile applications for Android/iOS access. Targets CUI group with break-glass exclusion. Evidence proves mobile device access is controlled per AC.L2-3.1.18.

entries.label: BYOD Non-Browser Client Block CA Policies
entries.notes: Collects enabled Conditional Access policies targeting non-browser client app types (mobile/desktop clients, Exchange ActiveSync). Evidence proves BYOD non-browser access is blocked or requires compliant/domain-joined devices.

entries.label: BYOD Non-Browser Sign-In Failures (Runtime Sample)
entries.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/auditLogs/signIns?`$filter=clientAppUsed ne 'Browser' and conditionalAccessStatus eq 'failure'&`$top=10&`$orderby=createdDateTime desc").value | Select-Object userPrincipalName,appDisplayName,clientAppUsed,conditionalAccessStatus,createdDateTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
evidence_commands: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/auditLogs/signIns?`$filter=clientAppUsed ne 'Browser' and conditionalAccessStatus eq 'failure'&`$top=10&`$orderby=createdDateTime desc").value | Select-Object userPrincipalName,appDisplayName,clientAppUsed,conditionalAccessStatus,createdDateTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
entries.notes: Runtime sample. Zero results noted but not failure -- may mean no attempts occurred.

entries.label: BYOD DLP Compliance Policies
entries.notes: Collects enabled DLP compliance policies and their associated rules. Evidence proves DLP coverage for CUI data loss prevention on BYOD endpoints.

entries.label: BYOD DLP Rule Match Audit Events (Runtime Sample)
entries.notes: Runtime sample of DLP matches in last 30 days. Zero noted but not failure. Uses ComplianceDLPExchange record type (DLPRuleMatch is not a valid enum value).

entries.label: BYOD Sensitivity Labels Configuration
entries.notes: Collects sensitivity label configuration including encryption settings and label policies. Evidence proves sensitivity labels with encryption are deployed for CUI protection on BYOD endpoints.

entries.label: BYOD Sensitivity Label Usage Audit Events (Runtime Sample)
entries.notes: Runtime sample of label application events in last 30 days.

entries.label: Deploy iOS MAM App Protection Policy
entries.notes: Deploys an iOS Mobile Application Management (MAM) policy restricting data storage to OneDrive/SharePoint, blocking backup, and requiring device compliance. Evidence proves CUI encryption on mobile platforms per AC.L2-3.1.19.

entries.label: Restrict Guest Invitations via Authorization Policy
entries.notes: Restricts guest invitations to admins and guest inviters only. Disables email-based subscription signups and email-verified user join. Evidence proves external system connections are controlled per AC.L1-3.1.20.

entries.label: Disable SharePoint External Sharing at Tenant Level
entries.notes: Disables SharePoint Online external sharing at the tenant level via Graph beta admin/sharepoint/settings endpoint. Evidence proves external information system use is restricted per AC.L1-3.1.20. Uses beta endpoint — no v1.0 equivalent for this setting.

entries.label: Block Removable Storage via Intune Device Configuration
entries.notes: Deploys an Intune device configuration policy blocking removable storage on Windows 10/11 devices. Evidence proves portable storage device use is restricted on external systems per AC.L2-3.1.21.

entries.label: Verify SharePoint Site Sharing Restricted (tenant-level 'disabled' covers site-level)
entries.notes: Uses admin/sharepoint/settings endpoint (Graph sites/{hostname} returns BadRequest on GCC High ITAR). Tenant-level 'disabled' (set by AC.L2-3.1.20.spo-sharing) inherently restricts all sites. This entry verifies the posture only.

entries.label: Security Awareness Training Evidence Collection
evidence_commands: @{archetype='EMX-TRAINING-001';status='manual_upload_required';instructions='Upload LMS completion report (CSV/PDF) with employee_id, completion_date, course_name';assessor_expects='Training completion rates for in-scope personnel'} | ConvertTo-Json

@{archetype='EMX-TRAINING-002';status='manual_upload_required';instructions='Upload role-based training completion report for privileged/technical roles';assessor_expects='Evidence privileged users receive role-specific training'} | ConvertTo-Json
entries.notes: Attack Simulation Training API is NOT available in GCC High (US Gov L4). Evidence must be collected manually from Defender portal.

entries.label: Insider Threat Awareness Program Evidence
entries.notes: Collects Insider Risk Management policy configuration as evidence. Runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell (IPPS) session.

entries.label: Enable Organization Customization (Pre-requisite for Audit)
entries.notes: Enable-OrganizationCustomization errors if already customized (IsDehydrated=false). Use get-then-set: skip if IsDehydrated is already false. Uses -ExpandProperty to get bare True/False value (tabular Select-Object returns empty in GCC High).

entries.label: Enable Unified Audit Log Ingestion
entries.notes: Enables Unified Audit Log ingestion in Exchange Online. This is a prerequisite for all M365 audit capabilities. Evidence proves audit logging is active for system activity monitoring per AU.L2-3.3.1.

entries.label: Create Audit Log Retention Policy (1 Year)
entries.set_command: if (-not (Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -eq 'CMMC-1Year-Retention')) { New-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy -Name 'CMMC-1Year-Retention' -Description 'CMMC AU retention 1 year' -RetentionDuration TwelveMonths -Priority 1 -RecordTypes AzureActiveDirectory,ExchangeAdmin,SharePoint,OneDrive } else { Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -eq 'CMMC-1Year-Retention' | Select-Object Name,RetentionDuration }
entries.get_command: Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -like 'CMMC*' | Select-Object Name,RetentionDuration | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
entries.notes: Creates a 12-month audit log retention policy covering AAD, Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive record types. Runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell (IPPS). Evidence proves audit records are retained to enable investigation per AU.L2-3.3.1.

entries.label: Sign-In and Directory Audit Log Evidence
evidence_commands: Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Filter "activityDisplayName eq 'Add member to role' and activityDateTime ge $((Get-Date).AddDays(-30).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'))" -Top 100 | Select-Object ActivityDisplayName,ActivityDateTime,InitiatedBy,TargetResources | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
entries.notes: Evidence-only. Collects Entra ID sign-in and directory audit logs for the past 30 days. Evidence proves individual user actions are uniquely traceable for accountability per AU.L2-3.3.2.

entries.label: Connect Office 365 Data Connector to Sentinel
entries.set_command: $f = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'stamper-sentinel-body.json'; @{kind='Office365';properties=@{tenantId='{tenantId}';dataTypes=@{exchange=@{state='Enabled'};sharePoint=@{state='Enabled'};teams=@{state='Enabled'}}}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress | Set-Content -Path $f -Encoding UTF8; az rest --method PUT --url 'https://management.usgovcloudapi.net/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{lawWorkspaceName}/providers/Microsoft.SecurityInsights/dataConnectors/office365?api-version=2024-03-01' --headers Content-Type=application/json --body "@$f"; Remove-Item $f -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
entries.notes: Migrated to az rest with explicit GCC High endpoint (management.usgovcloudapi.net). Uses static connector ID 'office365' following AZ-SEN-001 pattern. Requires subscriptionId, tenantId from config; Global Admin or Security Admin role at tenant level plus workspace write permissions.

entries.label: Audit Log Search Evidence (Reduce/Review Capability)
evidence_commands: Search-UnifiedAuditLog -StartDate (Get-Date).AddDays(-7) -EndDate (Get-Date) -RecordType ExchangeAdmin -ResultSize 5000 -SessionCommand ReturnLargeSet | Select-Object CreationDate,UserIds,Operations,Status | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
entries.notes: Evidence-only. Runs a Unified Audit Log search covering the past 7 days of ExchangeAdmin records. Demonstrates audit record review and correlation capability per AU.L2-3.3.5. Runs in Exchange Online PowerShell session.

entries.label: Audit Reduction via Compliance Search
evidence_commands: Get-ComplianceSearch | Where-Object Name -like 'CMMC-Audit*' | Select-Object Name,Status,Items,CreatedTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Creates a Compliance Search for audit log reduction per AU.L2-3.3.6. Runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell (IPPS) session.

entries.label: Audit Log Search and Report Generation Evidence
entries.notes: Runtime sample of Exchange admin audit logs (7-day window). Demonstrates audit reduction and report generation capability per AU.L2-3.3.6. Zero results noted but not failure.

entries.label: Authoritative Time Source Verification (Platform Inherited)
entries.notes: M365 GCC High inherits Microsoft NTP infrastructure. No set_command needed — platform-managed. Get-command collects organization metadata with timestamps as evidence.

entries.label: Audit Log Access Restriction - Compliance Admin Role Evidence
evidence_commands: Get-MgDirectoryRole -Filter "displayName eq 'Compliance Administrator'" -All | ForEach-Object { Get-MgDirectoryRoleMember -DirectoryRoleId $_.Id -All | Select-Object Id,AdditionalProperties } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
entries.notes: Read-only evidence collection — no set_command. The evidence_command resolves the Compliance Administrator role definition dynamically. The get_command uses the pre-resolved complianceRoleId variable.

entries.label: Deploy Windows Security Baseline via Intune Template
entries.notes: Requires Intune device management. Skip if no managed devices. Uses /beta endpoint — may not be available in all GCC High tenants.

entries.label: Deploy Attack Surface Reduction Rules via Intune Configuration Policy
entries.set_command: $body = '{"name":"CMMC-ASR-Rules","description":"CMMC CM.L2-3.4.2 Attack Surface Reduction Rules","platforms":"windows10","technologies":"mdm","settings":[{"settingInstance":{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationGroupSettingCollectionInstance","settingDefinitionId":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules","groupSettingCollectionValue":[{"children":[{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance","settingDefinitionId":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockcontent","choiceSettingValue":{"value":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockcontent_block","children":[]}},{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance","settingDefinitionId":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockofficechildprocess","choiceSettingValue":{"value":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockofficechildprocess_block","children":[]}},{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance","settingDefinitionId":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockcredentialstealing","choiceSettingValue":{"value":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockcredentialstealing_block","children":[]}},{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance","settingDefinitionId":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockuntrustedusb","choiceSettingValue":{"value":"device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_attacksurfacereductionrules_blockuntrustedusb_block","children":[]}}]}]}}]}'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/configurationPolicies' -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
entries.notes: Uses /beta endpoint — no v1.0 equivalent exists for configuration policies. Body is raw JSON string to avoid PowerShell hashtable-to-JSON conversion issues with nested @odata.type fields.

entries.label: Configuration Change Tracking via Intune Audit Log
entries.notes: Evidence-only. No set_command — nothing to configure. SAT if audit events exist (confirms change tracking active). Human review required to confirm changes were authorized.

entries.label: Security Impact Analysis of Changes (Manual Process Gate)
evidence_commands: Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Filter "category eq 'ApplicationManagement' or category eq 'Policy' or category eq 'UserManagement'" -All -Top 500 | Select-Object ActivityDisplayName,ActivityDateTime,InitiatedBy,TargetResources | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Manual gate for security impact analysis of configuration changes. Evidence command collects recent Entra ID directory audit events for ApplicationManagement, Policy, and UserManagement categories. Human review required to confirm changes were analyzed before implementation per CM.L2-3.4.4.

entries.label: Access Restriction for Configuration Changes via Role Assignments
entries.get_command: Get-MgDirectoryRole | Where-Object {$_.DisplayName -in @('Intune Administrator','Global Administrator','Cloud Device Administrator','Security Administrator')} | ForEach-Object { $role = $_; Get-MgDirectoryRoleMember -DirectoryRoleId $role.Id | Select-Object @{N='Role';E={$role.DisplayName}},Id,@{N='Type';E={$_.'@odata.type'}}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
evidence_commands: Get-MgDirectoryRole | Where-Object {$_.DisplayName -in @('Intune Administrator','Global Administrator','Cloud Device Administrator','Security Administrator')} | ForEach-Object { $role = $_; Get-MgDirectoryRoleMember -DirectoryRoleId $role.Id | Select-Object @{N='Role';E={$role.DisplayName}},Id,@{N='Type';E={$_.'@odata.type'}}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
Get-MgPolicyRoleManagementPolicyAssignment -Filter "scopeId eq '/' and scopeType eq 'DirectoryRole'" | Select-Object PolicyId,RoleDefinitionId,ScopeId | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
entries.notes: Evidence-only. No set_command. SAT if role assignments exist confirming access restrictions are in place. Human review required to confirm role members are authorized personnel only.

entries.label: Enforce Least Functionality - Disable Cortana and MSIA
entries.notes: Deploys Intune device configuration blocking Cortana and Microsoft Sign-In Assistant. Reduces unnecessary platform services on managed devices. Evidence proves least functionality principle per CM.L2-3.4.6.

entries.label: WDAC Application Control Policy via Intune
entries.notes: Deploys application control policy via Intune — SmartScreen enforcement + sideloading block. Full WDAC XML policy deployment requires OMA-URI custom profile (separate step).

entries.label: Detected Applications Inventory Evidence via Intune
entries.notes: Evidence-only. Queries Conditional Access policies showing application-level grant controls (the deny-by-exception enforcement mechanism in cloud-only environments). CA policies restrict which applications users can access and under what conditions. Combined with Intune MAM policies (app protection), this implements software allow/deny listing without requiring device enrollment. Evidence proves deny-by-exception policy per CM.L2-3.4.8.

entries.label: Intune App Protection and Defender Application Control Evidence
entries.notes: Collects Intune App Protection policies and Defender ASR rules. Evidence proves application allow/deny enforcement per CM.L2-3.4.8.

entries.label: User Software Installation Control via Intune
entries.notes: Blocks sideloading and developer unlock via Intune device configuration. Prevents unauthorized software installation per CM.L2-3.4.9.

entries.label: User and Device Identification Evidence
entries.notes: Evidence-only. Queries enabled users via Graph REST (GCC High endpoint). Proves user identification management for IA.L1-3.5.1 and device authentication via IA.L1-3.5.2. User provisioning covered by AC.L2-3.1.1; device compliance by CA policies.

entries.label: Enable Microsoft Authenticator Authentication Method
entries.notes: Enables Microsoft Authenticator as an authentication method in the tenant authentication methods policy. Evidence proves MFA capability is available for all accounts per IA.L2-3.5.3.

entries.label: Enable FIDO2 Security Key Authentication Method
entries.notes: Enables FIDO2 security key as an authentication method. FIDO2 provides phishing-resistant MFA using hardware security keys. Evidence proves replay-resistant, phishing-resistant authentication is available per IA.L2-3.5.3.

entries.label: Create Phishing-Resistant Authentication Strength Policy
entries.notes: Creates a custom authentication strength policy requiring FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, or x509 certificate multi-factor authentication. Captures phishingResistantStrengthId for use in Conditional Access policies. Evidence proves replay-resistant authentication mechanisms per IA.L2-3.5.4.

entries.label: Disable Inactive Accounts Inactive 90+ Days
entries.set_command: Get-MgUser -Filter 'accountEnabled eq true' -All -Property DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-90) -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{operatorUPN}' -and $_.UserPrincipalName -ne '{breakGlassUPN}' } | ForEach-Object { Update-MgUser -UserId $_.Id -AccountEnabled:$false }
evidence_commands: Get-MgUser -Filter 'accountEnabled eq true' -All -Property DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Disables user accounts that have been inactive for 90+ days. Excludes operator and break-glass accounts. Evidence proves identifiers are disabled after a defined period of inactivity per IA.L2-3.5.5 and IA.L2-3.5.6.

entries.label: Enable Azure AD Password Protection and Banned Password List
entries.notes: Azure AD Password Protection (banned password list) is configured via Entra ID portal > Authentication Methods > Password Protection. The Graph API /settings endpoint does not support this configuration. On-prem AD requires Azure AD Password Protection agent. get_command returns authenticationMethodsPolicy as proxy evidence.

entries.label: Password Reuse Prevention Evidence
entries.notes: Evidence-only. Queries auth methods policy (which methods are enabled/disabled) and CA policies with authentication strength requirements. Entra ID cloud-only tenants inherit platform password reuse prevention. For passwordless deployments (FIDO2/cert-based), password reuse is moot — auth strength policies prove this. Evidence proves password reuse prevention per IA.L2-3.5.8.

entries.label: Entra ID Password Protection Policy Settings
entries.notes: Collects Entra ID password protection settings. Evidence proves password reuse prevention is enforced per IA.L2-3.5.8.

entries.label: Configure Temporary Access Pass (One-Time Use, 60 Minutes)
entries.notes: GCC High requires full @odata.type in PATCH body or isUsableOnce is silently ignored. Requires Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod app permission.

entries.label: Enable Certificate-Based Authentication Method
entries.notes: Enables x509 certificate-based authentication in the tenant authentication methods policy. CBA provides cryptographic proof of identity without transmitting passwords. Evidence proves passwords are stored and transmitted only in cryptographically protected form per IA.L2-3.5.10.

entries.label: Login Page Branding Evidence (Password Obscured by Platform)
evidence_commands: Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/organization' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty value | Select-Object displayName,verifiedDomains | ConvertTo-Json
entries.notes: Platform control — login page obscures password by default

entries.label: Enable Defender for Office 365 ATP for SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive
entries.notes: Enables Defender for Office 365 Advanced Threat Protection for SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive. Provides real-time file scanning and detonation in these workloads. Evidence proves incident preparation and detection capability per IR.L2-3.6.1.

entries.label: Enable File Type Filtering in Default Malware Filter Policy
entries.notes: Enables file type filtering in the Default malware filter policy. Blocks known-malicious file types at the Exchange transport layer. Evidence proves malware detection and containment per IR.L2-3.6.1.

entries.label: Sentinel Incident Tracking and Response Evidence
entries.notes: Requires 'Microsoft Sentinel Reader' role on the resource group

entries.label: Launch Attack Simulation for Incident Response Testing
entries.notes: Attack Simulation Training API is NOT available in GCC High (US Gov L4). get_command returns recent security alerts as proxy evidence of active incident detection. Must use Defender portal or third-party tool for actual attack simulation.

entries.label: Deploy Windows Update for Business Ring via Intune
entries.notes: Deploys a Windows Update for Business ring via Intune with 7-day quality update deferral, 30-day feature update deferral, and auto-install at scheduled time. Evidence proves system maintenance is performed via automated patching per MA.L2-3.7.1 and MA.L2-3.7.2.

entries.label: Media Malware Check via Defender AV Evidence
entries.notes: Media malware scanning is enforced by Microsoft Defender Antivirus (real-time protection). Get-command collects Defender compliance policy evidence.

entries.label: MFA for Remote Maintenance via Conditional Access
evidence_commands: Get-MgIdentityConditionalAccessPolicy | Where-Object DisplayName -like 'CMMC-RemoteMaintenance*' | Select-Object DisplayName,State,CreatedDateTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Creates CA policy requiring MFA for Global Admin and Security Admin roles from non-trusted locations. Policy is created in report-only mode — operator must enable after review.

entries.label: Supervised Maintenance by Authorized Personnel (Manual Gate)
evidence_commands: Get-MgAuditLogSignIn -Filter "appDisplayName eq 'Azure Bastion' or appDisplayName eq 'Remote Desktop'" -All -Top 500 | Select-Object UserPrincipalName,AppDisplayName,CreatedDateTime,IpAddress,ResourceDisplayName | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
entries.notes: Physical/process control — no automation surface

entries.label: Create CUI Sensitivity Label with Encryption
entries.set_command: New-Label -Name 'CUI' -DisplayName 'CUI - Controlled Unclassified Information' -Tooltip 'Contains CUI' -EncryptionEnabled $true -EncryptionProtectionType Template -EncryptionEncryptOnly $false
entries.notes: Creates a 'CUI' sensitivity label with encryption enabled in Security & Compliance PowerShell. Covers MP.L2-3.8.1 (protect media), MP.L2-3.8.2 (limit access), and MP.L2-3.8.4 (CUI marking). Evidence proves CUI markings and encryption are available for digital media.

entries.label: Publish CUI Sensitivity Label Policy to All Workloads
